capabilities: : Parse and connect referenced files with edges
: Color nodes based on type (skill, agent, reference)
: Visualize AI agent skill structures in Graph View
disambiguation: Not a general-purpose graph visualization tool; it is specifically designed to interpret and display AI agent skill structures.
extras: The plugin is read-only and does not modify original files. It is currently desktop-only and may require symlinks for multi-directory vaults.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin to visualize OpenClaw / Claude Code agent skill structures in graph view.
problem: It addresses the difficulty in visually mapping the complex relationships and structures of AI agent skills defined across multiple files.

relations.evidence: The agent↔skill vault this plugin visualizes is best produced by skill-graph-builder

summary: Visualizes AI agent skill structures in Obsidian's Graph View by parsing YAML frontmatter and drawing reference edges between skill nodes and referenced files.
